prompt: Generate one image: a finished, high-fidelity desktop website landing page design, 16:9 landscape, rendered edge to edge as the page itself (no browser window, no device, no desk). Two images are attached. Image 1 shows the REAL Lonca logomark and icon: reproduce that exact mark (pixel-block icon + blocky "lonca" wordmark), single flat colour (light on dark), never redraw or restyle it. Image 2 is a STYLE reference sheet only (Nango primary, plus Linear, Vercel, Resend): match its craft, near-black ground, hairline grid lines framing a centred content column, crisp neutral greys, one accent colour, refined grotesk type, small mono labels, real code cards; do NOT copy any of their text, logos or products. Product: Lonca, an open-source-engine marketplace integrator for Turkish marketplace sellers (Trendyol, Hepsiburada; n11 coming). The seller panel is coming soon, small sellers will always be free, the open-source TypeScript SDKs exist today. Accent colour: Lonca blue #3D7BE0 on near-black #0A0B0D, text #EDEFF2, muted #8A919C, hairlines #1E2228. All page text in Turkish. Composition A (Nango-like split hero inside the hairline grid). 1. Top nav: exact Lonca logomark left; links "Satıcılar", "Geliştiriciler", "Fiyatlar", "Dokümanlar"; at right a GitHub star chip and a white pill button "Bekleme listesi". 2. Hero left column: small mono eyebrow "AÇIK KAYNAK MOTOR · MIT"; headline "Pazaryeri entegrasyonu, yıllık lisans olmadan."; subline "Trendyol ve Hepsiburada için açık kaynak motorlu entegratör. Lonca Panel yakında; küçük satıcıya her zaman ücretsiz."; inline form: email field "E-posta adresin" + accent button "Bekleme listesine yazıl"; under it a mono line "Geliştiriciysen: npm i @lonca/trendyol →". 3. THE FOCAL MOVE, hero right column: a dark panel card in the same style as a code card, titled "Lonca Panel" with a small badge "Konsept · örnek veri": a live order list with Turkish order numbers, ₺ amounts and channel tags "Trendyol" / "Hepsiburada", the newest row highlighted as just arrived; beside it a small stock card "Stok: 41 · 3 kanalda senkron". 4. Below the hero, a full-width hairline-divided status strip of three cells: "● Trendyol · canlıda doğrulandı", "● Hepsiburada · canlıda doğrulandı", "◐ n11 · geliştiriliyor". 5. The start of the next section: centred heading "Amiral gemisi özellikleri. Lisans faturası yok." with the top of a two-column comparison table beginning below. Body text at real readable size. Real content only: no customer logos, no testimonials, no user counts, no marketplace logos (names in plain text are fine), no competitor names, no prices for paid plans.
